verses.verse:
अन्तः परिधि मानेन मुखरन्ध्राच्चतुगुणे।
परिमाणे पंचमोमध्यो यदि मन्द्रो दशमे स्थितः।।२३।।
verses.text: By the measure of the inner circumference, at four times from the mouth-hole lies the middle Pañcama, if the lower one lies at the tenth.

commentary.text: That is, if the other end of the pipe is at ten times from the mukharandhra (mouth-hole), then, taking that as mandra (lower) Pañcama, the Pañcama of the madhya saptaka (middle octave) must be taken at four times the distance from the mouth-hole. That is, if Pañcama is ten inches from the mouth-hole, place the second Pañcama four inches from the mouth-hole. Here it is not necessary that the length of the pipe be exactly ten times the paridhimāna (measure of the circumference). The length of the pipe can also be 7 or 8 times the paridhimāna; but we have to place madhya Pañcama by dividing that length into five equal parts and taking 2/5, or into ten parts and taking 4/10, because the remaining notes have to be placed taking just these two Pañcamas as pillars. If the far end of the pipe is not natural but artificial, that is if a hole is made and taken as the end, then in this case madhya Pañcama can be placed not at 4/10 but at 5/12. See the figure.
